test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

I suppose dancing that well would require a lot of __actual application__.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**practice'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"practice"** means the actual application or use of an idea, belief, or method, as opposed to theories about such application or use. (अभ्यास)

 
 
• **Example: **She needs more **practice **to improve her piano skills.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct substitute is **practice.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prevention **(रोकथाम): The action of stopping something from happening or arising.

 
 
• **Example:** Vaccines are crucial for the **prevention **of diseases.
 
 
 
• **Perseverance **(धैर्य): Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
 
 
• **Example: **Her **perseverance **paid off when she finally won the championship.
 
 
 
• **Perception** (अनुभूति): The ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses.
 
 
• **Example:** His keen **perception **allowed him to notice details that others missed.
